patch.description: Admins can set any status except DELIVERED, which can only be reached via the two-party verify-delivery flow. A rider may only update an order for the leg they are approved on: the pickup rider can set PICKED_UP / IN_TRANSIT / AT_WAREHOUSE, the delivery rider can set OUT_FOR_DELIVERY / DELIVERED_PENDING_VERIFICATION, and FAILED_DELIVERY is settable by whichever leg currently holds the parcel.

info.title: GoDelivery API
info.description: Delivery platform API — phone OTP auth, shipment creation & tracking, weight/distance-based pricing, and 3rd-party integration via API keys.

landmark.description: Nearest recognizable landmark, e.g. "Near City Hospital"

placeId.description: Google Maps place_id, when picked from the map

formattedAddress.description: Google Maps formatted_address, when picked from the map

refreshToken.description: Revoke only this refresh token; omit to revoke every session for the account

sentOrdersCount.description: Orders placed by this account as a sender

receivedOrdersCount.description: Orders addressed to this account as a receiver

riderOrdersCount.description: Orders this account has handled as a rider, pickup and delivery legs combined

sentOrdersCount.description: Orders placed by this account as a sender

receivedOrdersCount.description: Orders addressed to this account as a receiver

riderOrdersCount.description: Orders this account has handled as a rider, pickup and delivery legs combined

id.description: The rider's user id — also what appears as Order.pickupRider.id / Order.deliveryRider.id / AssignRiderDto.riderId

isAvailable.description: true = online and open to new deliveries, false = offline

orderId.description: The delivery currently in progress, if any

totalDeliveries.description: Count of orders this rider has delivered

averageDeliveryDurationMinutes.description: Average minutes from pickup to delivery

baseFare.description: Flat fee applied to every order
Flat fee applied to every order

location.description: Replaces the warehouse's location details in place — the underlying Location row is updated, not swapped.

isActive.description: Deactivating a warehouse takes it out of nearest-warehouse routing for new orders — in-flight orders already assigned to it are unaffected.

imageAssetIds.description: MediaAsset ids returned by POST /media/uploads, to attach as this package's photos

senderName.description: Overrides the sender's account name for this shipment only

paymentMethod.description: Only Cash actually settles today — other methods just tag the order for now (see PaymentMethod).

codAmount.description: Cash amount the rider should collect from the receiver for the goods themselves, separate from the delivery charge. Leave unset if nothing needs to be collected from the receiver on delivery.

pickupLocation.description: Pickup point for this order. Defaults to the sender's registered shop location.

pickupRider.description: Rider handling the pickup leg — collects the parcel from the sender and brings it to `warehouse`

pickupRiderClaimRequestedAt.description: Set while a pickup self-claim is awaiting admin approval; null once approved (or if the rider was assigned directly by an admin)

warehouse.description: The warehouse this order is routed through — nearest active one to the pickup location, assigned at order creation

warehouseArrivedAt.description: Set by the pickup rider once the parcel is dropped at the warehouse — this is what makes the order visible for the delivery leg

deliveryRider.description: Rider handling the delivery leg — collects the parcel from `warehouse` and delivers it to the receiver

deliveryRiderClaimRequestedAt.description: Set while a delivery self-claim is awaiting admin approval; null once approved (or if the rider was assigned directly by an admin)

codAmount.description: Cash amount to collect from the receiver for the goods themselves, separate from the delivery charge

signature.description: Receiver's captured signature, as a PNG data URL (proof of receipt alongside the confirmation click).

id.description: Existing Package id to update — this endpoint edits packages in place, it does not add or remove them

deliveryLocation.description: Replaces the delivery address in place — the underlying Location row is updated, not swapped.

packages.description: Edits to existing packages, matched by id. Changing weightKg or isDangerous on any package (or changing deliveryLocation) re-runs pricing so the charged amount stays accurate.

riderId.description: User id of an active rider

deviceIdentifier.description: Stable id generated once by the client and reused across launches

granted.description: true to grant consent, false to withdraw it and erase previously submitted data

orderId.description: Order this feedback relates to, if any

deviceId.description: Device this feedback/bug report was filed from, if any

secret.description: Full secret — shown once, store it now
